items.t: Mattamy Homes donates 125 acres in Martin County to support St. Lucie River restoration
items.x: Developer Mattamy Homes is transferring 125 acres to Martin County in support of restoring the St. Lucie River.

items.t: 15-year-old driver accused of fleeing Stuart police going the wrong way, crashing into car
items.x: A wrong-way pursuit on U.S. 1 ended in a serious crash early Tuesday morning after a driver accused of fleeing Stuart police drove into oncoming traffic.

items.t: Device as small as 'grain of rice' offers hope for rare eye disease
items.x: A tiny implant is providing a groundbreaking treatment for macular telangiectasia, a rare eye disease, by slowing or stopping its progression.

items.t: Best friends become rivals during World Series
items.x: Two best friends have become temporary rivals as their MLB teams face each other in the World Series.

items.t: Milwaukee's William Contreras wins World Series MVP
items.x: William Contreras became the eighth catcher voted the World Series MVP after lifting the Milwaukee Brewers to their first World Series championship.

items.t: Milwaukee Brewers win first World Series with ties to Palm Beach County
items.x: The Milwaukee Brewers claimed their first World Series title, with manager Pat Murphy and pitcher Shane Drohan both having connections to Palm Beach County.

items.t: Family remembers Road Ranger killed on I-95 as loving father, caretaker
items.x: The family of 23-year-old Road Ranger Kalibe Combs is speaking out after he was killed while working at an I-95 crash scene near Lantana Road.

items.t: Brewers win first World Series title
items.x: The small-ball Milwaukee Brewers, playing in the smallest market in the majors, are World Series champions for the first time in franchise history.

items.t: Milwaukee Brewers win first World Series title, beating Tampa Bay Rays in Game 5
items.x: The Milwaukee Brewers have won their first World Series title in franchise history, defeating the Tampa Bay Rays 4-1 in Game 5.

items.t: King tide flooding and erosion impact South Florida
items.x: King tide flooding and high winds are causing significant erosion and damage along the Palm Beach County shoreline and along the Treasure Coast, with locals witnessing debris and structural collapses.

items.t: Boca Raton names Jim Zervis as interim city manager
items.x: The Boca Raton City Council has appointed Deputy City Manager and Chief Financial Officer Jim Zervis as interim city manager following the resignation of Mark Sohaney earlier this month.

items.t: 'Still in the middle of this': Coastal erosion impacts Vero Beach as king tides and strong winds persist
items.x: King tides and strong onshore winds have caused significant coastal erosion in Vero Beach, with officials describing the damage as approaching severe and taking steps to address public safety concerns.

items.t: Dylan Dantas convicted of second-degree murder in 2023 Boca Raton shooting
items.x: Dylan Dantas was found guilty of second-degree murder and firearm possession by a minor in the 2023 shooting death of another teen at his home.

items.t: Health Department takes another look at St Lucie County glioblastoma cases
items.x: Nearly eight years after WPTV first investigated concerns about a possible cluster of glioblastoma cases in St. Lucie County, health officials have reviewed the numbers again.

items.t: Margaritaville cruise passengers react to weather delay at Port of Palm Beach
items.x: Passengers of Margaritaville at Sea Paradise shared mixed feelings after unfavorable weather delayed their return by a day, with some enjoying the perks and others frustrated by the inconvenience.

items.t: Cooper Pratt sets World Series record
items.x: Cooper Pratt has made World Series history. He has had six straight hits while at bat, the most of any rookie in history for the championship game.

items.t: Judge denies federal request to segregate California ballots, says it would 'wreak havoc' on voting
items.x: A federal judge rejected on Wednesday a Trump administration request to stop California from processing the ballots of up to 20,000 people over allegations they are likely noncitizens.
